name: 44092 · Wickliffe, OH
findings: ZIP 44092 (Wickliffe) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44092 (Wickliffe) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44092 (Wickliffe) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44092 (Wickliffe) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
